projects.name: SCSimulator: An Exploratory Visual Analytics Framework for Partner Selection in Supply Chains through LLM-driven Multi-Agent Simulation
highlights: Proposed a framework integrating LLM-driven multi-agent simulation with human-in-the-loop collaboration for supply-chain partner selection.
Designed a visual analytics system supporting dynamic network exploration, agent-level intervention, and simulation path branching.
Integrated predictive modeling, SHAP-based explainable AI, and chain-of-thought reasoning to explain agent decisions and network impacts.
Evaluated the system through quantitative simulation evaluation, a usage scenario, and expert user studies.

projects.name: CommSense: Facilitating Bias-Aware and Reflective Navigation of Online Comments for Rational Judgment
highlights: Investigated a four-stage judgment process: initial framing, evidence foraging, belief updating, and synthesis and judgment.
Led a co-design workshop to derive four design requirements for bias mitigation.
Designed and implemented overview visualization, structured annotation, reflective prompts, and synthesis scaffolding.
Conducted user studies demonstrating improved bias awareness, reflective reasoning, and evidence-based judgment while maintaining high usability.

projects.name: From Requirement to Solution: Unveiling Problem-Driven Design Patterns in Visual Analytics
highlights: Developed a methodology for meta-analysis of visual analytics research from a problem-driven perspective.
Contributed a solution typology and refined requirement and data typologies to update visual analytics abstraction frameworks.
Represented problem-solving practices through a dense, directed, weighted graph.
